_readme: Hand-kept partner entries. Each entry: id, name, type (logistics | service), tags, summary, facts (label/value), notes (dated lines), contacts, source. Supplier notes go in supplierNotes, keyed by the supplier name used in odm.json.

partners.name: Feili hub
partners.summary: The regional hub. Parts wait here until a picklist sends them to an NS.

facts.label: Flow
facts.value: The RO orders the total for all NS; the ODM ships to the hub, which splits it by NS.

facts.label: Stock
facts.value: Feili Inventory = open picklists + Stock in HUB. NS + Feili = AAP.

facts.label: Valuation
facts.value: Held at the cost it came in at; it does not move with exchange rates.

facts.label: Monthly mails
facts.value: PLS_Picklist_Monthly and PLS_Stock_Monthly on the 1st: open picklists and stock in the hub.

partners.name: HSN Group
partners.summary: Acer Group affiliate. From 1 Dec 2026 the parts PAP buys reach the NS through HSN Group; PAP still does the purchasing.

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Delivery path from PAP to the NS, from 1 Dec 2026.

facts.label: Before December POs
facts.value: Check how the PO entities change.

partners.name: ACA
partners.summary: Australia's service company. ACNZ (New Zealand) sits under ACA.

partners.name: AIL
partners.summary: Service company (NS). Has its own CSS instance, shared with ABD.

partners.name: ABD
partners.summary: Kept in the AIL CSS instance. Left out of WH Stock AAP Total.

facts.label: Inventory report
facts.value: Not in WH Stock AAP Total

partners.name: AJC
partners.summary: Japan's service company. Also manages AKC (Korea).

partners.name: AKC
partners.summary: Korea, managed by AJC. No branches in CSS. Left out of WH Stock AAP Total.

partners.name: TBG
partners.summary: Taiwan. TW, TWN and TBG all mean Taiwan. Counted in PAP but not in AAP.

facts.label: Inventory
facts.value: Reported in the first week of the month; TPM (third-party repair) is Taiwan only.

partners.name: ASP
partners.summary: Authorised service centres. They use PLM and CSS; repair cases are recorded in CSS.

notes: 2026-11-18: For AAP's extra (Non-FCST) demand of 40 × 27.J1HNG.001 (POWER CORD 1M EU), BMORN confirmed 40 pcs but asked for the PO against 27.DLQNG.001 at USD 2 (system price of J1HNG: USD 1). No substitute chain links the two in the Critical Report.
LTB shipments follow a 9-month schedule (others: 12 months), partial per RO.
